details.flavorMarkdown: *An elegant undead predator with cool skin, immaculate clothes and teeth easily concealed by a practiced smile. Its household and social influence protect a carefully hidden feeding arrangement.*
details.specialtyMarkdown:
### Life-drinking bite

*The victim pales as a stolen flush of warmth returns to the attacker’s face.*

**Target:** One adjacent creature. **Player defense:** Fortitude. **Damage type:** Life.

**Weak defense:** Recover up to 2 HP actually drained. **Standard defense:** Recover up to 1 HP actually drained.

**Limit:** Restoration cannot exceed actual HP removed or maximum HP. This is explicitly undead-compatible life theft, not ordinary healing.

### Borrowed Face

Take the appearance and voice of a person of the same footprint, until dismissed or reduced to 0 HP. Keep statistics and equipment; gain no memories, languages or powers. Suspicious examination uses normal player Reason. Direct sunlight prevents this ability and ends the disguise.
details.generalMarkdown:
### General details

**Basic Melee:** One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

**Defend:** Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

**Opportunity Attack:** Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

**Weakness:** Direct sunlight ends Borrowed Face and prevents using it.

**Lifeless Body:** does not breathe or eat; only the listed immunities apply.

**Healing:** Healing-harmed: ordinary healing resolves as Life damage instead; no beneficial riders.

**Against offensive healing:** controller defends with Fortitude if this is player-controlled; a player attacking it still rolls only their attack.

**Senses:** Ordinary sight and hearing.

**Signs:** Servants prepare dinner but no one ever sees the host eat.

**Purpose:** Preserve a luxurious refuge and a supply of willing or deceived victims.

**Tactics and retreat:** Separate a guest from companions and drink life; escape if the household turns against them.

**Counterplay and conversation:** Reveal the feeding arrangement, open the shutters, and deny private meetings.

**Habitat:** Manor; city · **Communication:** Common and court languages

**Loot:** Fine ordinary clothes, 100 coins and evidence of local bargains.

**Summoning:** Ineligible.
details.designNotesMarkdown:
## Design notes — not needed during play

**ID:** creature-blood-courtier


**Category:** Undead · **Role:** Predator · **CV:** 40

### Creature-roll reference

| Attack | Attribute | Attack modifier | Weak attack | Standard attack | Strong attack |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Life-drinking bite | Guile | 1 Boon | 4 Life damage. | 6 Life damage. Recover up to 1 HP actually drained. | 8 Life damage. Recover up to 2 HP actually drained. |

The incoming attack names the defense attribute; use the six values above. Same targeting, costs and limits apply in either perspective. No opposed second roll.


### CV worksheet

**Difficulty rationale:** An agile or elusive body warrants attack Banes. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

**Reference damage:** 4/6/8

**Reference type:** Life

**Expected targets:** 1

**Utility factor:** 1.45

**Regeneration per turn:** 0

Reference I=2.404, O=6.596. CV uses the [seed worksheet](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/bestiary/encounters.md); action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.

**Ability sources:** [borrowed face](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/borrowed-face.md), [life drink](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/life-drink.md), [lifeless body](https://github.com/bruceamoser/heroes-of-legend/blob/9bc9b4fe3256e68880b92c45facf0f25b98a1ea3/design/monster-abilities/lifeless-body.md).
